title: 游玩专家
concept: 金色旅行箱躺在迷你头等舱座椅上
revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art for achievement_medal_travel_tier_004, to be converted into a transparent 768x768 app asset
Primary request: Create one absurd but premium collectible travel achievement medal for the Chinese title concept "游玩专家" (play expert who enjoys trips paid for by someone else). The image itself must contain no text.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal, full object visible with generous padding. The medal has a chunky beveled gold rim and a glossy turquoise enamel center. Main visual gag: ONE shiny gold travel suitcase reclining lazily in ONE tiny first-class airplane seat, as if enjoying a trip someone else paid for. Add one tiny drink cup as part of the seat comfort gag, no other props.
Style/medium: polished mobile game collectible, semi-3D hand-painted enamel pin / toy medal hybrid, playful deliberate nonsense, premium material finish, raised gold metal, glossy enamel, crisp edges, shiny highlights, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: large readable silhouette, suitcase and seat centered, seat visible but not overpowering, full medal visible with generous padding, no cropping.
Lighting/mood: indulgent comfort, bright studio rim light, candy-like specular highlights, smug vacation luxury.
Color palette: saturated metallic gold suitcase, electric turquoise enamel, deep navy or burgundy seat, tiny white drink cup, coral or ruby rim accents, white glints. Do not use #ff00ff anywhere in the medal or subject.
Materials/textures: raised gold metal, glossy enamel, lacquered toy-like surfaces, plush seat, small glossy cup, beveled rim, smooth hand-painted shading. No paper grain.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no people, no animals, no maps, no compass, no leaves, no ticket, no camera, no neck pillow, no blanket, no airplane body, no window, no rocket, no globe, no gold bars, no coins, no money pile, no confetti, no postage stamp edge, no paper texture, no vintage scrapbook look, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
